name: inspection-expert

displayDescription.en: Cloud resource inspection expert. Covers five-dimension inspection (security, performance, reliability, cost, compliance), high-risk scanning and prioritized remediation, inspection trend analysis, and visual report generation. Proactively discovers hidden risks before they become incidents.
